admission.justification: An unanswered tool would otherwise leave the sweep and the run blocked with no end to the wait; the named deadline stops the sweep at the first such tool while the control proves the failure fires and the handler closes.

applicability: Every call the tool entry-point sweep makes through its one world, in the session-initialization, tool-response and session-cleanup phases.
conditions: A passed phase limit names the tool and the phase in a `_ToolCallTimeout`.
exclusions: The pins, the classifier's arms and the swept population are unchanged by this obligation.
The environment in which the tests end with an ordinary verdict is a separate recorded limitation, not part of this obligation.

evidence: host-sweep-module: 16 passed; f5-no-deadline: target reached, passive dump and owned 50-second outer limit; managed-sweep-envelope and managed-sweep-pin: class setup not finished at owned 180-second outer limits, no ordinary pytest verdict.

statement: The existing sweep awaits initialization, response and cleanup with sixty-second phase budgets and surfaces its named deadline outside the product-raiser classifier.
